title: Admin Emails template list and preview
summary: Admins can now open Admin, Emails to see every email MyAPES Account sends and preview each one with sample data.
changes: Add Emails to the Admin menu and Admin search for Administrators and Super Admins.
List every email with its category, owner, and whether it respects the Email contact preference.
Preview each email with sample data and your own name in a locked-down frame; previews never send mail.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.42 line: a new read-only Admin page and two new Admin permissions.
validation: Authorization, Admin access, and permission matrix tests.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Send test, resend verification, the outbound log, and wording changes arrive in later 0.42 releases.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. The migration only adds two permission rows, which the previous release ignores.
